title: 翻片矩阵字标组装｜像素激活、平面组字、厚度长出与卡片收束
source_title: 机械翻牌字标｜单词组件化组装与回弹
summary: 固定翻片矩阵从局部激活扩散成完整单词，平面字形随后长出厚度、分层和少量点色，所有组件保持注册并回弹落稳，最后缩入简洁品牌卡。
input_format: Establish one fixed cell matrix, one exact short word and a neutral unflipped baseline. + Propagate local cell activation until the complete flat word is readable without misspelling. + Grow registered letter depth, layers and one accent while preserving every character position. + Use bounded extrusion and recoil so modules return to a stable aligned state. + Compress the resolved dimensional word into one clean card and hold the exact lockup.
recommended_input: 展示原创小方形陶瓷砖墙，全部哑光象牙色并固定在正交网格；预先声明准确单词【MAKER】，但尚不显示字母。；所有瓷砖注册不变，字母砖长成浅陶瓷浮雕；只在字母 A 上方增加一个小琥珀方块。；拉远，完整浮雕字变成锈色背景上的小象牙工坊卡；准确【MAKER】与一个琥珀方块停住，不加其他文字。
required_anchors: Establish one fixed cell matrix, one exact short word and a neutral unflipped baseline.
Propagate local cell activation until the complete flat word is readable without misspelling.
Use bounded extrusion and recoil so modules return to a stable aligned state.
Compress the resolved dimensional word into one clean card and hold the exact lockup.
